summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Valuevade landing page with new referral system and SVG logo updates. All backend APIs working correctly, frontend fully functional with referral leaderboard, copy functionality, and end-to-end referral flow.

fixed_bugs.issue: Existing entries without referral fields caused 500 errors on duplicate email
fixed_bugs.fix_applied: Added migration logic to handle existing entries without referral_code/referral_count fields

passed_tests: Backend API root endpoint returns correct message
Waitlist count endpoint works correctly
POST /api/waitlist creates entry with 6-char alphanumeric referral_code
POST /api/waitlist with ref_code credits referrer (position -5, referral_count +1)
GET /api/waitlist/leaderboard returns top referrers sorted by referral_count desc
GET /api/waitlist/stats/{referral_code} returns referral stats with correct link format
Duplicate email handling returns existing entry with referral fields
Email validation prevents invalid email formats
404 handling for invalid referral codes
SVG logo displayed correctly in Navbar (/valuevade-logo.svg)
SVG logo displayed correctly in Footer (/valuevade-logo.svg)
Landing page loads with all sections
Waitlist form submission using proper data-testid selectors
WaitlistConfirmation page loads with position badge
Referral count badge displays correctly (0 referrals initially)
Referral link box shows correct format with ?ref=CODE
Copy button functionality works (clipboard copy)
Referral leaderboard renders with multiple entries
URL parameter ?ref=CODE handling works correctly
End-to-end referral flow: referrer position decreases by 5, referral_count increases by 1

success_percentage.backend: 100% (13/13 tests passed - all referral system APIs working)
success_percentage.frontend: 100% (all SVG logos, referral features, and end-to-end flow working)
success_percentage.integration: 100% (waitlist submission to confirmation with referral system working perfectly)
